(1) the solution of the Stokes flow in a domain of thickness e with a rough boundary converges, in the two-scale sense, to the solution of a limit problem; (2) the limit problem is the Stokes flow in an infinite strip with a periodic rough boundary and the Tresca fluid solid interface condition on the boundary; and (3) the solution of this limit problem is unique.
